# Kabsi

Your reviews and listing. Taken care of.

> Kabsi looks after a local business on Google: a reply ready for every new review, your hours and details kept right, and fresh posts. The owner approves every change, and nothing is published until the owner approves it. Kabsi is independent and not affiliated with Google.

Key facts:

- What it is: a service that looks after the Google Business Profile of a local business, in any country. Names: Reviews, Google Profile, Google Protection, Get Reviews, Weekly Care Report.
- What needs attention: a short list of the next improvements, marked Urgent, Recommended or Nice to have, each with a reason and a ready draft where Kabsi can write one. Kabsi gives no score and does not predict rankings.
- Who can use it: a verified Google Business Profile that the owner owns or manages, for a business that meets customers in person during stated hours, or a service-area business that travels to customers. Not eligible under Google's guidelines: online-only businesses, rental or for-sale properties, PO boxes and virtual offices used as an address, and other cases Google lists.
- How it connects: the owner adds the Kabsi group ID 5481006796 as a Manager on their Google Business Profile. The owner keeps full ownership and can remove Kabsi at any time.
- Reviews: each new review gets a draft reply in the reviewer's language (for example English, Spanish, Arabic or French). Drafts only use facts the owner gave Kabsi, make no promises of money, and are checked before they reach the owner. Hard reviews get a calm draft with no one-tap Approve button.
- Google Profile: post drafts (optional), photo checks before publishing, special and holiday hours. All of it waits for the owner's approval; nothing is published on a schedule.
- Google Protection: watches the listing's name, phone, address, hours, website and category, and emails the owner when one changes on Google. The owner chooses: Google is right, or Keep my information. Nothing changes unless the owner says so. It cannot lock a listing.
- Weekly Care Report: every Monday, the public Google rating, new reviews, how many got a reply, and review link opens. Facts only.
- Nora: Kabsi's assistant. She answers questions on the site and in the dashboard, and helps owners fill in their business facts. She is an AI and says so when asked.
- Get Reviews (review link and QR code): free in every country. They open the business's own Google review form for every customer. There is no filtering of unhappy customers. Ask every customer the same way, as they visit. Never offer a reward. Opens are counted as opens, not reviews. An owner who already has an NFC tag can write the same link on it. Kabsi sells an NFC card and setup bundle only in Lebanon.
- What Kabsi does not do: it does not promise more reviews, higher ratings or better rankings, it cannot remove reviews, and it does not publish or change anything without approval.
- Prices (USD, every country): Kabsi Pro $19 a month or $190 a year, extra locations $15 a month or $150 a year, with a 14-day free trial and no card (30 days through a partner). Free: review link, QR code and a printable table card. Monthly plans cancel any time; yearly plans are refundable within 14 days. In Lebanon only: a $120 a year bundle with Pro, an NFC card and setup. Partners (card sellers and agencies): $8 per active business per month.
- Google data: review text and reviewer names are kept at most 30 days after Google last returned them.
- Compared with Gemini in Business Profile: Gemini is Google's free assistant for one verified profile that the owner opens and asks. Kabsi comes to the owner with a reply already prepared, tells the owner when Google changes the listing, writes only from facts the owner confirmed, and has a person behind it. Source: https://support.google.com/business/answer/17142585
- Operator and contact: Kabsi is operated by Hussein Slim, Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Contact: hello@kabsi.co
